subject: S15 needs append-only edits to packages/shared/ui-copy.defaults.json and noHardcodedCopy.test.ts (you hold them)
body: S15 adds ui_copy keys (ingest.*, library.*) and the regenerated ui-copy.defaults.json, plus 'src/library' to the source roots in apps/web/src/content/noHardcodedCopy.test.ts. Both are append-only; I will rebase onto yours at integrate time and regenerate defaults from the merged app_config.yaml. OK, or tell me when you release.
